# Agenda 0.9.0
- Uses a rounded Mac app icon in the Dock and Finder. - Adds a Recents menu for recently touched todos. - Shows a todo's id above its title on hover. - Evens out spacing between single-line and multi-line titles. - Keeps lab-note links readable in dark mode. - Opens note links in Chrome. - Moves Add todo into each project card, inserts a new todo at the top of its group, and lets you insert one between existing tasks. - Keeps the new-todo field focused after you add a task, and types into search when the board is filtered. - Fixes a freeze after rearranging tasks and lag after status clicks.

# Agenda 0.8.0
- Adds a past-day accomplishments view to the header timeline. - Keeps the overview intentionally compact: project names plus task and point counts. - Expands each project on click to show its exact completed tasks. - Supports internal scrolling for long accomplishment days. - Improves Agenda Pulse placement and gives stale items a distinct yellow treatment. - Uses a standard gear icon for Settings.

# Agenda 0.7.0
- Makes Agenda fully local-first: no third-party model calls or provider API keys. - Removes the retired assistant sidebar and detail-suggestion controls. - Keeps Apple-local title shortening and Agenda Pulse, with deterministic fallbacks. - Removes the retired OpenAI credential from the login Keychain on first launch. - Preserves historical assistant and suggestion records in the local database without exposing them.
